# Market chart gallery

Full indicator panels for broad markets and commodities. Values are derived from Yahoo Finance, FRED, and Statistics Denmark data available at build time.

## S&P 500 {#gallery-sp500}
```{r fig.height=30,fig.width=10}
draw_plots(data = df_adjusted %>% filter(ticker=="^GSPC",currency=="USD"),
           lines = list(c(ymd("2020-03-23"),ymd("2023-10-30")),
                        c(ymd("2018-01-20"),ymd("2022-01-01")))
           )
```

## Nasdaq {#gallery-nasdaq}
